cost_basis.historical: Superseded EUR 93.30/year and EUR 200–300/year estimates are recorded in EKA_STATUS_2026-10-23.md (EKA-39); neither is a current cost basis.
cost_basis.one_time: Separate USD registration charge in the community statement; excluded from recurring totals.
cost_basis.other_recurring: Separate USD annual account charge in the dated community statement; excluded from EUR subtotal; current invoice needs operator confirmation.
cost_basis.statement: docs/community.html (October 2026 operator estimate, not an invoice)
cost_basis.usage_dependent: HLR, translation and archival publication depend on usage, plan and funding; no current annual total is derivable from the repo.

definitions.api_endpoints: FastAPI route decorators (@router/@app .get/.post/.put/.patch/.delete) in apps/api/main.py and apps/api/routers/*.py.
definitions.api_routers: Python modules in apps/api/routers that declare at least one route.
definitions.db_tables_orm: __tablename__ declarations in apps/api/models.py (migration-only tables not counted).
definitions.modules_listed: Entries in the /health module list of apps/api/main.py.
definitions.modules_spec: Highest module number in the /health module list (MOD-01 … MOD-NN).
